asset.name: EditorAdapter
asset.description: Connects rich text, Markdown, code, and JSON fields to lazily loaded editor implementations behind one value, selection, and validation contract.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: Lazy loading is enforced at this seam. Editor implementations are the single largest thing that can end up in a base bundle, and the adapter boundary is what keeps them out of it.
